description: Bounce and complaint rates exactly as the sending limits judge them: the state (healthy, warning, limited = daily limit halved, paused = sending suspended), how many bounces counted and how many did not, and how many more bounces would reach the next state. Use it to explain a DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED or SENDING_SUSPENDED error, or before a large send.

not_counted.description: Bounces about our sending infrastructure, not the address.

measured.description: False until at least 100 recipients have a delivery result.
